data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'verax', meaning 'true' or 'real'. In Christian tradition, this name represents authenticity and truth in one's beliefs and actions. The name Verile carries the meaning “True, authentic, real” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Verile usually hope their child will grow to embody true, authentic, real and live with faith, good character and purpose.
